reasoning: Nigeria had 39.7% bank account penetration in 2017. To reach 95% by end of 2024 (less than 1 year away) would require adding ~55 percentage points in ~7 years, or ~7.9 points annually. While Nigeria has made progress in financial inclusion through mobile banking and CBN initiatives, reaching 95% penetration is extremely ambitious. Most recent data suggests penetration is still well below 95%. The 2024 deadline has essentially passed, making 2025 resolution unlikely to show 95% achievement.
